sections.description: Reader favorites, placement blocks, email/Google sign-in, member management and consent-based Kit, Mailchimp and Flodesk subscriptions.
sections.changelog:
= 0.3.15 =
* Add the shared MTT brand mark to the settings heading with local assets and reserved dimensions.

= 0.3.14 =
* Add a newsletter setting to start the signup checkbox checked, preserving reader choice and separate email-link confirmation. Existing installations remain unchecked until enabled.

= 0.3.13 =
* Simplify settings into Save buttons, Reader accounts, Newsletter and Appearance with outcome-focused labels and native switches.
* Show related setup only when needed, retain hidden values on save, and add an in-page color sample.
* Keep uncommon placement, signup tags, reporting and diagnostics in advanced disclosures.

= 0.3.12 =
* Consolidate Settings and Members under one Favorites admin page with accessible navigation tabs and redirects for old member links.
* Improve member filters, consent and delivery labels, empty states, responsive tables and readable activity reports while preserving secured exports and retries.

= 0.3.11 =
* Add a short Google credential setup guide and explain the site-specific return URL.
* Clarify secret retention and removal, showing the delete option only when a secret is stored.

= 0.3.10 =
* Adopt the shared MTT settings toolkit as an independently bundled stylesheet, with consistent spacing and 44px save controls.
* Keep Favorites as the reference implementation while preserving existing settings and credential behavior.

= 0.3.9 =
* Add a local-only newsletter preview with optional opt-in, separate confirmation and simulated delivery without credentials or subscriber writes.
* Ignore previews on production sites and pause real newsletter delivery during local previews.

= 0.3.8 =
* Standardize settings with section cards, stacked labels and full-width native controls, responsive spacing and consistent save actions.
* Associate field help text with its controls and preserve all saved settings and encrypted credentials.

= 0.3.7 =
* Keep the saved-heart sign-up action stationary on hover and focus by moving invitation spacing into its layout.

= 0.3.6 =
* Reveal the floating Favorites heart after three seconds and initial saved-state loading, with a gentle fade that respects reduced motion.
* Keep the delayed control hidden from keyboard and assistive technology until it appears.

= 0.3.5 =
* Unify hover and keyboard-focus feedback across reader and settings controls with gentle color transitions.
* Keep button geometry stable, focus outlines immediate and transitions disabled for reduced motion.

= 0.3.4 =
* Improve settings navigation, compact appearance controls and optional Google/source-tag setup without hiding or disabling saved fields.
* Add library search result counts and a clear-search action that restores input focus.
* Keep settings save and diagnostic forms independently named and nonce-protected.

= 0.3.3 =
* Restore signed-in favorite hearts and counts on page load without requiring a click.

= 0.3.2 =
* Keep quiet-button padding stable on hover so Account settings and header navigation do not shift.

= 0.3.1 =
* Unify dialog widths, header navigation, typography, spacing and button states across the library, sign-in and account settings.
* Group account identity in a clear card, simplify supporting copy and use consistent outlined account actions.
* Consolidate frontend styles and isolate interactive states from theme heading and button overrides while preserving keyboard focus and mobile targets.

= 0.3.0 =
* Enable dynamically inserted hearts and apply site palettes to shortcodes and recipe adapters; honor block color and font-size controls.
* Free capacity used by unavailable content, retain browser merge overflow, and preserve all saved IDs in paginated privacy exports.
* Add administrator readiness diagnostics and a read-only newsletter destination check, plus optional private most-saved reporting.
* Recover interrupted final newsletter deliveries, report failed storage writes, and include merged favorites in placement events.
* Return compact save responses, reuse unchanged list markup, avoid guest-removal requests, and keep inline-list focus in its originating library.

= 0.2.9 =
* Move signed-in identity, Google linking, sign-out and account deletion into a separate Account settings view.
* Keep the favorites library focused on search and saved content, with brief sign-in feedback and accessible view navigation.

= 0.2.8 =
* Apply reusable typography roles across labels, headings, descriptions, recipe titles and buttons.
* Give sign-in one clear heading and move return navigation below the main action.

= 0.2.7 =
* Use quiet icon controls for saved-list removal, retaining tooltips, accessible names and full touch targets.

= 0.2.6 =
* Place a compact personal saved-count badge above the floating heart.
* Add site-wide Appearance color settings for all Favorites components.

= 0.2.5 =
* Keep library headings, search and sign-in controls visible while saved items scroll independently.
* Give optional sign-in and saved-item actions clear secondary button styling.

= 0.2.4 =
* Keep guest saves on the recipe with brief confirmation instead of automatic sign-in modals.
* Open compact, non-modal saved-heart options with explicit removal and optional sign-in.
* Refine shared dialog styling, recipe thumbnails, mobile list layout and sign-in actions.

= 0.2.3 =
* Add optional heart pop and burst feedback after successful saves, respecting reduced motion.
* Organize settings into scoped WordPress editor-style panels for placement, interaction, accounts and newsletters.

= 0.2.2 =
* Open a saved-item action dialog on repeated heart clicks, keeping removal explicit.
* Unify scoped buttons, dialogs, fields and saved-item cards with reusable design tokens.
* Hide empty counts and decode titles before safely rendering them as text.

= 0.2.1 =
* Add shared, pseudonymous audience events with deduplication, 90-day retention and WordPress privacy export/erasure.

= 0.2.0 =
* Add verified Google sign-in, optional required sign-in, searchable thumbnail lists and configurable invitations.
* Add member management, consent-safe retries, source tags, native search and WP Recipe Maker adapters, and shared audience events.

= 0.1.0 =
* Add reader favorites, dynamic placement blocks, recipe shortcodes, content exclusions and an optional floating sidebar.
* Add passwordless email verification, cross-device favorite merging, consent-based Kit/Mailchimp/Flodesk delivery and privacy tools.
